@pytest.mark.parametrize("account", ["Acme Holdings", "Smith & Co"])
def test_account_names_with_special_characters_are_encoded(client, api, account):
    # Send each call twice so both edge nodes see it
    for _ in range(2):
        exports = client.list_exports(account)
        reports = client.list_reports(account, since=datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        assert exports and all(e.account == account for e in exports)
        assert reports and all(r.account == account for r in reports)
    assert len(api.requests) == 4  # no retries needed


def test_search_query_with_ampersand(client):
    assert [a.name for a in client.search_accounts("Smith & Co")] == ["Smith & Co"]
